title: Nobiletin's role in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis via the PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53 signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Tingyuan; Wang, Jing; Bai, Le; Zhao, Qi; Zhu, Dongwei; Xu, Yong; Wang, Yongsheng; Wang, Zhichao; Feng, Fanchao; Zhou, Xianmei
one_liner_zh: 研究药物Nobiletin通过PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53通路治疗肺纤维化，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: To explore the therapeutic effects of Nobiletin (NOB) on Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and to identify its targets and molecular pathways. We verified the inhibitory effect of NOB on the senescence of A549 cells through in vitro experiments, and the inhibitory effect of NOB on the migration ability of fibroblasts was verified by the Transwell experiment. The inhibitory effects of NOB on Idiopathic IPF were subsequently assessed in a mouse model induced by bleomycin (BLM). Through PPI network, gene ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis, the PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53 signaling pathway was identified as the critical pathway. The key proteins in the signaling pathway were verified by molecular docking and western blotting. NOB showed a great inhibitory effect on A549 cell senescence and Fibroblast migration. Meanwhile, NOB reduced BLM-induced collagen deposition in mouse lung tissues and inhibited alveolar epithelial cell (AEC) senescence. Through PPI network, P53 was screened as a core target of NOB. According to functional enrichment analysis results, the PI3K/AKT signaling was believed to have played an important role. Therefore, we speculate that the PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53 signaling pathway mediated NOB's impact on IPF. These findings were validated through molecular docking and western blotting. This study demonstrated that NOB suppressed cell senescence to protect IPF through mediating the PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 旨在探讨川陈皮素（Nobiletin, NOB）对特发性肺纤维化（Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, IPF）的治疗效果，并识别其靶点及分子通路。通过体外实验验证了NOB对A549细胞衰老的抑制作用，并通过Transwell实验验证了NOB对成纤维细胞迁移能力的抑制效果。随后，在博来霉素（bleomycin, BLM）诱导的小鼠模型中评估了NOB对特发性IPF的抑制作用。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络、基因本体论（gene ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）富集分析，确定了PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53信号通路为关键通路。通过分子对接和蛋白质印迹法验证了该信号通路中的关键蛋白。NOB对A549细胞衰老和成纤维细胞迁移表现出显著的抑制作用。同时，NOB减少了BLM诱导的小鼠肺组织中的胶原沉积，并抑制了肺泡上皮细胞（alveolar epithelial cell, AEC）的衰老。通过PPI网络，P53被筛选为NOB的核心靶点。根据功能富集分析结果，认为PI3K/AKT信号通路发挥了重要作用。因此，我们推测PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53信号通路介导了NOB对IPF的影响。这些发现通过分子对接和蛋白质印迹法得到了验证。本研究证明，NOB通过介导PI3K/AKT/MDM2/p53信号通路抑制细胞衰老，从而保护IPF。
